$comment: Second batch of Orochia's default pictures (candidates, ~2x the target): generate all, review on the contact sheet, keep the best, then add the kept ones to apps/web/lib/presets.manifest.json (with alt EN/FR). Same rules as profile-media.json: adults only, every identity, no stereotype, no real person, no text or logo, never sexualised, violet to magenta palette. Avatars 1024 square -> 512 and 256 webp. Banners generated at 1536x512 (3:1) -> 1600 and 800 webp.
style: Palette: deep violet to magenta accents, premium and next-gen, readable on light and dark. Clean composition, soft light, no text, no lettering, no logos, fully clothed, wholesome, clearly adult.
